verdict.rationale: Proa ships an official CLI (`cargo install proa-cli`) that scaffolds a new project with `proa new site hello-proa --yes`. It also offers ready-made starters, including a kitchen-sink starter and the ORIGIN template via `--template origin`. The docs say the scaffolded app starts an Axum dev server on localhost:3000 that restarts when Rust, style, or config files change. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that setup actually takes only a few minutes, and the exact run/dev command is not quoted in the evidence.
